title: The French e-invoicing rules (BR-FR) a Cross Industry Invoice from a French seller meets
source: FNFE-MPE France_RFE 1.4.0, FNFE_RFE_INVOICE/CII/EN16931/schematron/BR-FR-Flux2-Schematron-CII.sch and the XP Z12-012 annex A rule sheet (BR-France CTC), read 2026-10-09. AFNOR XP Z12-012 itself is sold by AFNOR and is cited only. The whole rule set reaches a file through EINV-FR-CTC; the rules below are also restated in skills/_checks/fr_invoice_check.py and skills/e-invoice/scripts/einvoice_create.py.

rules.text: For a French seller, the KoSIT validator with the EN 16931 CII schematron and the FNFE-MPE BR-FR rules accepts the XML; skipped when the validator is not installed.
Every invoice carries the notes PMT (the 40 euro indemnity), PMD (the late-payment penalties) and AAB (the discount or its absence).
Each of the notes PMD, PMT, AAB and TXD appears once.
The billing framework (BT-23) is given: B1 goods, S1 services, M1 both, and the other listed codes for paid, final, subcontracted, e-reported, multi-seller and two-way invoices.
A SIRET (scheme 0009) has 14 digits and starts with the SIREN.
The seller's SIREN (BT-30) is given, nine digits.
For the e-invoicing scope (note BAR = B2B), the buyer's SIREN (BT-47) is given, nine digits.
The buyer's electronic address (BT-49) is given (BR-FR-12 checks that it is there).
The seller's electronic address (BT-34) is given.
The VAT rate is one of the French rates (20, 10, 5.5, 2.1 and the overseas and Corsican rates), in percent.
VAT due on debits is BT-8 = 5 in CII.
